profile.headline: JPMorganChase
profile.summary: I am a person who values and appreciates all learning experiences. I want to build stronger character in myself as well as radiate it to my fellow associates and clients. I value those who want to better themselves and can add to my growth as a person. I strive to challenge myself and overcome all obstacles on my path to success. I love to work and feel accomplished even if there isn't any recognition to obtain. I want to HELP people in any way possible.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Bootstrap · HTML5 · JavaScript · HTML · Python · jQuery · Java · JavaSE

positions.title: Mechanical Assembler
positions.description:
	Interpret prints, drawings and sketches. Set up and perform hand and automatic assembly operations on components, sub-assemblies and assemblies. 
	Utilize calipers and micrometers to measure inlets, orifices, and all other components of a valve to verify company specifications. 
	Inspect components for surface flaws and defects in stem threads. Remove the malfunctioning valve with the help of hand tools, fix up a new valve in its position and tighten its grip. 
	Lubricate and wipe machines, tools and work area to maintain safety and cleanliness.

positions.title: Sales Specialist
positions.description:
	Provided a challenging environment for teams to progressively learn in any given scenario.
	Maintained the store’s integrity level via the incorporation of corporate standards and governance. 
	Employed company guidelines to effectively move and install merchandise in different locations of the store, utilizing the combination of power tools, wrenches, sockets, ratchets, hammers, drills.

positions.title: Sales Floor Team Member
positions.description:
	Delivered fast, fun and friendly service to Target guests, both face to face and through team member support. 
	Cultivated the brand experience by providing a consistently positive and welcoming environment for guests and fellow team members.
	Implemented and executed problem solving skills on the sales floor through customer engagement.
	As a part of the Logistics Team: Prepared and stocked merchandise on the sales floor while managing inventory.
	Utilized a variety of forklifts (stacker, pallet jack, and order picker) to unload, store, and secure stock.
